one_line: A skilled water–works organizer from the Hoysala agrarian heartland, overseeing temple-linked tank construction in 12th-century Karnataka.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, lean but sturdy build, physically active village official-artisan.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium-brown South Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp but kind eyes, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard along jawline; default expression focused and calm with a hint of determined pride.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair, parted slightly off-center, tied into a short, tidy knot at the back of the head; simple off-white cotton headband wrapped around the crown with the knot visible below it.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Hoysala rural attire: a knee-length, off-white handloom cotton tunic (kurta-like) with side slits, narrow brown edging at cuffs and hem; below, a cream-colored cotton dhoti wrapped and pleated forward, ending at the ankles, with a thin dark-green border; over the left shoulder a muted ochre cotton angavastra (shawl) draped diagonally across the torso and back, practical and unembroidered; simple brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery—small plain gold stud earrings and a black-thread amulet around the neck; a palm-leaf document roll tucked at the waist to hint at his administrative role.
appearance.signature: A long wooden measuring rod marked with carved notches, carried in the right hand, with a simple coiled rope and a small metal measuring cup hanging from the left hip to show his role in laying out tank embankments and checking water levels.

ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown Hoysala tank builder with a short knot of black hair and headband, off-white tunic, cream dhoti, ochre shoulder shawl, simple sandals and jewellery, carrying a wooden measuring rod with rope and metal cup in an off-white, cream, ochre, dark-green, brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style character sheet of a 12th-century Hoysala tank builder from Karnataka: lean, medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, kind but focused eyes, small moustache and short jawline beard; thick black hair tied in a short knot at the back, wrapped with a simple off-white cotton headband. He wears a knee-length off-white handloom cotton tunic with narrow brown edging at cuffs and hem, a cream-colored ankle-length dhoti with a thin dark-green border, and an ochre cotton shawl draped from the left shoulder across the torso and back. Simple brown leather sandals on his feet, small plain gold stud earrings, and a black-thread amulet around his neck; a rolled palm-leaf document is tucked at his waist. In his right hand he holds a long wooden measuring rod with carved notches, while a coiled rope and a small metal measuring cup hang at his left hip, emphasizing his role in planning and inspecting irrigation tanks. Show him front, three-quarter, and back views in consistent off-white, cream, ochre, dark green, and brown colors, keeping the design modest, historically grounded, and shonen-anime in energy and proportions.
